reason: The inference overstates the allowed external: immediately before Theorem 3.15, Hatcher sets up tensor products of modules over a commutative ring R, but node 1.1 asserts the result for an arbitrary coefficient ring R, including noncommutative rings. For noncommutative R, H*(X;R) tensor_R H*(Y;R) is not canonically a tensor product of two left R-modules, and the advertised graded tensor-product multiplication need not be well-defined. Therefore the cited theorem does not justify this scope; the node must restrict R to the commutative coefficient-ring setting of the source.
